title: Editing: Wonderful Christmastime by Paul McCartney | 1979
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eddie Klein

Paul McCartney edited ‘Wonderful Christmastime’ for release as a single on 14 October 1979.

The song had been recorded in July at McCartney’s home studios in Campbeltown and Sussex. Originally lasting 4:18, it was edited down to 3:49 on this day.
